jobs.occupation: Brand and Category Manager - FMCG - Confectionary company
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international FMCG company with a strong portfolio of well-established brands enjoyed by millions of consumers worldwide. Combining a rich heritage with a forward-thinking mindset, the company develops and markets high-quality products that are part of consumers' everyday lives.

With a significant international footprint, multiple production sites across several countries, and thousands of employees worldwide, the organization combines global scale with a strong local-market focus. Its success is driven by a deep understanding of consumer needs, continuous innovation, and a commitment to delivering products that consumers know, trust, and love.

The company offers a dynamic, collaborative, and entrepreneurial environment where employees are empowered to make an impact and contribute to the growth of iconic brands.

Jobomschrijving

The Brand & Category Manager is responsible for developing, managing, and driving the performance of the company's brands and product categories (sweet biscuits, chocolate, savoury).

This role leads the marketing strategy for the Belgium market, optimizes the product assortment, analyzes business performance, and ensures alignment between consumer needs, market trends, and business objectives, all while supporting the broader strategic vision of the group.Keys responsibilities and activities

Brand Management:

• Define and implement the annual marketing plan in terms of product portfolio, innovation, communication, consumer/shopper activation.
• Contribute to the preparation of the yearly marketing budget. Be responsible to follow up the spendings, making sure you stay aligned with the agreed yearly budget.
• Collaborate with the Netherlands, France, England and Turkey team on cross-border concepts, innovation launches. Recommend the relevant innovations and go-to market plan for Belgium market and prepare the launch plans.
• Manage the existing portfolio, including the potential updates driven by global teams and oversee the development of Point-of-Sale (POS) material.
• Implement the annual communication plan (social media, OOH and retail media campaigns).
• Implement and monitor the annual consumer/shopper activation's (consumer promotion, sampling, couponing campaign, Point Of Sale (POS) materials for field sale steam …)
• Analyse the activities results and take the conclusions into action plan and optimize investments and future strategies.
• Be in permanent contact with external agencies and internal stakeholders (production, logistics, finance, legal, marketing, new product development).
• Monitor and analyse brands and products performances.

Category Management:

• Analyse Categories to identify the growth drivers. Participate in key customer meetings to share the Category Perspective and insights.
• Analyse customer performances and shopper data to develop sharp sales argumentation for business review and customer presentations (Colruyt, Delhaize, Carrefour, Intermarché, HD).
• Guide and work closely with Sales teams to optimize brand plan execution.

• A bachelor's or master's degree, preferably in a commercial & marketing field.
• 4-6 years working experience in a similar role in FMCG sector.
• Strong analytical and project management skills and a feel for retail, sales, or marketing.
• You combine an analytical mind with creativity and present ideas clearly and convincingly.
• You speak French, Dutch & English.
• You are a sociable team player: flexible, driven, curious, and a strong communicator.
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
• Knowledge of Nielsen is required.

jobs.occupation: Hospitals Account Manager - Medical Devices - Flanders
jobs.description:
Our client is an international Medical Devices company specialized in hospital supplies & dialyses equipment. They are a major market player with more than 30.000 employees worldwide and a turnover of several billion euros. Being in constant growth, they invest a lot in R&D to propose qualitative and innovative products while remaining conscious of their environmental responsibility.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Hospitals Account Manager - Medical Devices (Renal Care & Nephrology) - Flanders, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain relationships with key stakeholders in the Hospital sector within Flanders (Specialists in Renal Care - mainly neurologist & Nurses) - Currently representing a portfolio of +8M
• Promote and sell Renal care products (Dialysis devices & related consumables) to hospitals in Flanders 
• Drive the business growth : Identify new business opportunities, expand market presence, ensure products cross selling & up selling, negotiate contracts ...
• Negotiate pricing, contracts and close agreements to maximize profits - including Tender Management responsibilities 
• Develop and execute strategic & tactical plans to achieve sales targets

As a successful Hospitals Account Manager - Medical Devices (Renal Care & Nephrology) - Flanders, you will have the following profile:

• Bachelor / Master degree in Nursing, Life Sciences, Business, or related field
• +5 years of commercial experiences within hospitals with medical devices
• Experiences in Renal Care is strongly preferred 
• Willingness to be on the road most of the time
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
• You are autonomous, independent & proactive
• Fluency in Dutch& English

Our client is a leading industrial manufacturing company investing in the expansion and modernization of one of its production sites.

Jobomschrijving

• Coordinate engineering activities from concept and feasibility studies through execution.
• Act as the interface between engineering, production, and project management teams.
• Support the delivery of multidisciplinary installations, including civil works, mechanical equipment, utilities, and electrical systems.
• Monitor project planning, technical coordination, and execution to ensure objectives are met.
• Contribute to the successful implementation of brownfield CAPEX projects within an operational production environment.

• Master's or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, or a multidisciplinary engineering background with a strong civil engineering foundation.
• Proven experience as a Project Engineer on industrial CAPEX projects, ideally in brownfield environments.
• Strong understanding of civil engineering with the ability to coordinate multidisciplinary technical activities.
• Excellent coordination and communication skills, with the ability to work across multiple stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch and English (mandatory).

● Knowledge of CMS Solutions (Drupal, WordPress and others)

jobs.occupation: Head of Information Technology - Advanced Manufacturing
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established multinational manufacturing organization with a strong presence in Thailand and global operations.

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and execute the company's IT strategy in alignment with business goals and long-term growth plans.
• Lead and manage the IT function, including infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, and IT service delivery.
• Oversee the reliability, security, and performance of enterprise technology environments.
• Partner with business leaders and cross-functional stakeholders to identify technology opportunities and address operational challenges.
• Drive digital transformation and continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
• Manage IT projects, ensuring timely delivery, budget compliance, and successful business outcomes.
• Establish and monitor IT governance, policies, risk management, and compliance frameworks.
• Oversee IT budget planning, vendor management, and resource allocation.
• Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends to enhance competitiveness and operational efficiency.

To apply online please click the 'Apply' button below. For a confidential discussion about this role please contact Gift Petto on +66 2 012 5067.

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. A Master's degree is an advantage.
• Minimum 15 years of IT experience, including significant leadership experience in a senior IT management role.
• Strong background in IT strategy, infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise applications, and IT governance.
• Experience leading IT teams within a manufacturing, industrial, or multinational environment is highly preferred.
• Demonstrated success in driving business-focused technology initiatives and digital transformation programs.
• Strong project and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
• Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.

• Strong customer service mindset and professional communication skills 
 
• Well-organised, able to manage priorities and meet deadlines 
 
• Detail-oriented, with a focus on quality, accuracy, and consistency

At Michael Page, you'll do much more than recruit. You'll act as a partner for both clients and candidates, helping businesses grow while changing careers and lives. This role offers an exciting combination of talent acquisition, consulting, and business development.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

Working at Michael Page means joining an entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and performance-driven environment where consultants are empowered to develop their own client portfolio, advise businesses on talent strategies, and make a real impact on people's careers. The company promotes a culture of teamwork, integrity, meritocracy, and continuous career development.

Omschrijving

As a Recruitment Consultant your responsibilities are:

• Develop and maintain strong relationships with clients and candidates.
• Identify and source top talent through various recruitment methods.
• Manage the full recruitment cycle, from job briefing to offer negotiation.
• Provide expert advice to clients on market trends and hiring strategies.
• Screen, interview, and assess candidates for suitability.
• Ensure a high standard of service delivery to both clients and candidates.

A successful Recruitment Consultant should have:

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• An ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English and French OR Dutch.
• Passion for sales, recruitment, and business development
• A proactive mindset.

Your Role
As an Alarm Technician, you will be responsible for the installation, programming, and maintenance of security systems. You will work on a variety of projects, ranging from private residences to large-scale commercial installations.
Your Responsibilities
• Install and connect alarm systems, fire detection systems, CCTV cameras, and access control systems.
• Configure and program detectors, control panels, and alarm transmission systems.
• Commission, test, and fine-tune installations in accordance with applicable standards and regulations.
• Diagnose and resolve technical issues and system malfunctions.
• Provide technical support and assistance to customers.
• Complete digital service reports and maintain accurate documentation of your work.
• Advise customers and recommend suitable security solutions.
Your Profile
• You hold a degree in Electricity, Electronics, or have equivalent technical experience.
• You have an interest in or experience with security systems, fire detection, and CCTV systems.
• A certification in fire detection and/or intrusion detection is an advantage, or you are willing to obtain one.
• You are accurate, independent, and solution-oriented.
• You hold a valid Category B driving licence.
• You are trustworthy, discreet, and customer-focused.
• You have an excellent command of English.
